scenes.text: Identify, explain and apply the important ideas behind how to start a computer safely.
Adult guidance: helps children learn safe routines. Power button: starts or shuts down a computer.
Clean dry hands: help protect electronic devices. Gentle touch: protects screens and keys. Save work: keeps a digital file for later.
Create a class safety demonstration. Show a good example of adult guidance and power button and explain why the good practice matters.
